messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Service degradation detected in ap-southeast2 (zone-c). Elevated 5xxs for model-serving nodes starting 1790006789. Auto-escalation to on-call. @raj (oncall) you're being paged.

raj (oncall): seeing it, joining. pulling logs now. can someone confirm whether this is egress or local node failure?

amy (eng-sre): quick check — control-plane shows healthy, but egress gateway to our mirror cluster is returning 502 from a subset of instances in zone-c. traceroute shows packet loss after the provider edge.

maria (support): we’ve had two customer tickets reporting generation failures in APAC, both mention timeouts ~12s then 502. customers: acme-inc, travelly, report-prod. adding to incident board.

raj (oncall): thanks. mitigating steps: 1) fail traffic for ap-southeast2/zone-c to fallback pools 2) spin up replacement nodes in the same zone if capacity allows 3) notify status page. executing step 1 now (traffic diversion).

deploy-bot: command received: rl route set --region ap-southeast2 --fallback-region ap-southeast3 --reason "egress gateway 5xx in zone-c" --dry=false

raj (oncall): diversion pushed. monitoring error rate and p95 latency. initial drop in 5xx within 60s but some residual errors for in-flight requests.

amy (eng-sre): starting node reprovision on the affected AZ; running health checks on the new nodes and ensuring KV cache priming after startup. if reprovision fails, we'll force-route traffic away from zone-c at AZ level.

tess (pm): rough customer impact guidance for comms: brief outage window ~10-30m, affecting APAC-serving customers primarily. recommend status page: "Partial degradation for ap-southeast2 — routing to fallback; users may experience transient 5xx or higher latency."

raj (oncall): drafting status page update now. posting proposed text for review: ```Status: Partial Degradation
Affected region: ap-southeast2 (zone-c)
Impact: Some API requests may return 5xx or experience increased latency. We are routing traffic to a fallback region (ap-southeast3) while we remediate the underlying egress gateway.
ETA: Monitoring; mitigation in progress. We'll update within 30 minutes or as appreciable progress occurs.```

maria (support): lgtm. customer notification template (short): ```Hi <Customer>,
We are investigating an intermittent service degradation affecting APAC-serving requests. Our engineers are routing traffic to a fallback region to reduce errors. You may see transient 5xx or slightly increased latency. We’ll send another update within 30 minutes and a follow-up once fully resolved. Sorry for the disruption. - Redwood Inference Ops```

amy (eng-sre): adding ops playbook snippet for on-call notes: ```Mitigation checklist:
- Confirm traffic diversion applied: rl route status --region ap-southeast2
- Monitor 5xx rate: prometheus query: sum(rate(http_server_errors_total[1m])) by (region,zone)
- If errors persist: escalate to network provider + open provider ticket with traceroute/logs
- Reprovision nodes: k8s: kubectl scale deployment/model-serve --replicas=3 -n ap-southeast2
- After reprovision: prime KV caches using cache-priming job: job/cache-prime --target ap-southeast2
- Rollback routing only when 5xx returns to baseline for 10m
```

ops-shift (handoff): handoff note for next on-call (timestamp 1790007400): divert is active, new nodes booting, 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 0.9% over 5m. customer impact limited to APAC but we received tickets from 3 accounts. leaving runbook in #eng-sre pinned. please continue watch and escalate to provider if error rate creeps >1.5%.

raj (oncall): raising provider ticket now, attaching traceroute and tcpdump excerpts. ETA from provider initial triage 30-60m.

tess (pm): internal comms to AE and success teams: ```Heads up: Partial APAC serving degradation in ap-southeast2 (zone-c). Traffic has been routed to fallback (ap-southeast3). A few customers reported 502/timeouts — we are mitigating; ETA TBD. Share this brief with any customers reaching out and escalate to SRE if any account reports significant data loss.```

maria (support): I posted the customer notification to all impacted accounts and added a note in our support UI. I'll update customers once we have provider confirmation or full recovery.

amy (eng-sre): provider triage says upstream peering flaps at provider edge in zone-c. recommended longer-term fix: move egress gateway pool to spread across b and c AZs, and add active health-check failover. filing infra ticket after incident.

raj (oncall): monitoring. next update in 15. if error rate stays <1% we can keep routing in place and prepare to drain fallback back when clean.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigation in progress. traffic routed to ap-southeast3; reprovisioning running; provider triage opened (ticket #PR-8423).

ops-shift (handoff): final handoff (1790007523): stable for 12m, 5xx ~0.4%. leaving routing diversion in place until provider confirms resolution. handoff to night on-call. please follow the playbook for rollback and customer follow-up. :white_check_mark:
